records.depth_scope: Isolated public reference arithmetic and aggregation on synthetic inputs only
records.finding: Negative rubric scores, missing negative-only tag score, mean-before-clipping and separate raw/length-adjusted output fields reproduced.
records.limitations: Not a clinical or model experiment. No claim that unpublished production evaluator has the same implementation or that reported scores are affected.
